project_brief.title: Stream Chat Swift (Production Realtime Messaging)
project_brief.description: Production-grade open-source chat client supporting WebSockets, Combine state binding, offline CoreData persistence, and SwiftUI views. Demonstrates realtime messaging architecture with modular components.

step_by_step_build_guide.title: WebSocket Transport Layer
step_by_step_build_guide.engineering_action: Implement a WebSocket client using URLSessionWebSocketTask with automatic reconnection, ping/pong keep-alive, and message serialization/deserialization.
step_by_step_build_guide.required_prereq_knowledge: Swift concurrency (async/await), URLSession, WebSocket protocol basics, JSON encoding/decoding.

step_by_step_build_guide.title: Combine State Binding & Event Stream
step_by_step_build_guide.engineering_action: Build a Combine-based event stream that transforms raw WebSocket messages into typed chat events (new message, typing indicator, reactions) and exposes them as publishers for UI binding.
step_by_step_build_guide.required_prereq_knowledge: Combine framework (Publishers, Subscribers, Subjects, Operators), reactive programming patterns, error handling in Combine.

step_by_step_build_guide.title: Offline CoreData Caching & Persistence
step_by_step_build_guide.engineering_action: Design and implement a CoreData stack for offline caching of messages and channels, including sync logic to reconcile network state with local storage and handle conflict resolution.
step_by_step_build_guide.required_prereq_knowledge: CoreData (NSManagedObjectModel, NSPersistentContainer, fetch requests, background contexts), offline-first data strategies, data modeling.

step_by_step_build_guide.title: SwiftUI View Components & Reactions
step_by_step_build_guide.engineering_action: Create reusable SwiftUI views for chat bubbles, reaction overlays, typing indicators, and message input field, binding them to the Combine state stream and CoreData store.
step_by_step_build_guide.required_prereq_knowledge: SwiftUI (View, @State, @ObservedObject, @EnvironmentObject), view composition, animation, and state-driven UI updates.

step_by_step_build_guide.title: Integration & Testing
step_by_step_build_guide.engineering_action: Integrate all layers (transport, state, persistence, UI) into a cohesive chat client, write unit tests for Combine pipelines and CoreData operations, and UI tests for SwiftUI views.
step_by_step_build_guide.required_prereq_knowledge: XCTest framework, mocking network and CoreData, testing Combine publishers, UI testing with XCUITest.

step_by_step_build_guide.title: Performance & Production Readiness
step_by_step_build_guide.engineering_action: Optimize WebSocket reconnection backoff, reduce memory footprint of CoreData cache, profile Combine subscriptions, and add logging/monitoring for production deployment.
step_by_step_build_guide.required_prereq_knowledge: Instruments for profiling, memory management in Swift, production deployment considerations (crash reporting, analytics).

tradeoffs_noted: Time conflict: project needs ~90h (6w × 15h/w baseline), learner has 80h (10h/w × 8w). Deficit: 10h (11% short).
Minor scope trim — omit integration test suite, focus on unit tests.

execution_model: Product-First Build Guide → Reverse Knowledge Mapping (45-Min Tasks)

rubric.language_syntax_idiom: Code adheres to standard Swift, SwiftUI, Combine, URLSessionWebSocketTask, CoreData conventions
rubric.error_handling: Code handles exceptions, network loss, and edge cases
